content.title: Chapter 6 - ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES — Sec. 6-142. - Special event permit application fee.
content.summary:
As permitted by C.R.S. § 44-5-107(2), a fee of $50.00 shall accompany each application
               for a special event permit to defray the local licensing authority's costs to investigate
               the application and issue the special event permit.
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018)
